description: The first-minute tutorial quest and the onboarding flow built on it (Features WV3, P8.core; catalog onboarding-tutorial-quest, onboarding-flow): the lessons as data (the control each teaches from CONTROL_BINDINGS, the events that complete it, the panel it highlights), one at a time in order, skip (never past an assessment), resume, and the onboarding_step_started / onboarding_step_completed / onboarding_completed events with their durations. Bindings are written as changes to core's CONTROL_BINDINGS (rebind, unbind). The clock starts at 2026-11-06T09:00:00.000Z and moves only on a tick (ms). Runner: src/quests/tutorial-corpus.ts (ops objectives, run, onboarding). Compared like the save-slots corpus. Regenerate with npm run title-onboarding-corpora; npm run title-onboarding-corpora:check fails on any difference.
sources: core a49056e src/game-engine/logic/TutorialQuestSystem.ts (the Babylon game's six lessons and their events; skipNonAssessmentObjectives) and OnboardingManager.ts (the adapter it replaces: start, completeCurrentStep, dispose); godot 6599874 templates/scripts/ui/onboarding_manager.gd (the merge tutorial: the inventory and combat lessons, skip, no combat lesson without combat); babylon bfcdeb2 shared/onboarding/onboarding-types.ts (step shape) and BabylonGame.tryLaunchTutorial.
Inputs are synthetic; every expected is core's answer, and src/game-engine/logic/__tests__/TutorialQuestSystem.test.ts pins the same rules independently.

contract.keysRule: a button: its first key's label (KeyE is E, Digit1 is 1, ArrowUp is Up); an axis: its single letters run together (WASD), else 'arrow keys' when every key is an arrow, else its first key; no key but the pointer: 'mouse'. {keys} in a hint or description is that text; the first letter is capitalised
contract.leftOutRule: a lesson whose control the bindings give no key and no pointer (or do not name) is not built
contract.orderRule: only the current lesson completes, on one of its completesOn events or the host; each event completes at most one; the next lesson is the next one not yet done
contract.skipRule: marks every lesson left that is not an assessment as skipped; then the first assessment left is current (announced), or the tutorial completes; refused when the game forbids it, the tutorial is over, or only assessments are left
contract.eventRule: onboarding_step_started when a lesson becomes current (the first on start), once per lesson; onboarding_step_completed with the ms since the lesson became current; onboarding_completed once, with the ms since the start. The start is the first start() that announces (startedAt is reset there); a tutorial driven without start() counts from its construction
contract.resumeRule: completedObjectiveIds are done before the start and never announced; the first lesson left is current; none left: complete from the start, nothing raised
contract.onboardingRule: no steps: generic is the tutorial, language adds the assessment; a step named like a lesson is that lesson; any other step is completed by the host or by its own completesOn, and is an assessment when its type is assessment or it says skippable: false; steps without an id and repeats are dropped; an unknown type is custom; prerequisites are not read (the order is the prerequisite); a lesson step that says skippable: false is an assessment too
contract.totalStepsRule: the manager's totalSteps is the step count of the flow built against the game's bindings, the same before start() as after it
contract.bindingsRule: the manager builds its flow against the game's bindings (options.bindings): an unbound lesson is left out, the hints name the game's keys
contract.nothingLeftRule: a flow with no step left (no steps, or every step in completedStepIds) calls onCompleted(totalSteps, 0) on start() and raises nothing on the bus
